register.labelZh: HIDE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: hide away 可以描述某人因為不開心、疲倦或不想見人而獨自躲起來。；當某人因其他人正在尋找自己而藏身在秘密地方時,可以使用 hide out。；hide something away 可以表示把禮物、金錢、信件或其他物品藏在不容易找到的地方。；HIDE 片語動詞能幫助你分辨把自己躲起來、藏身在秘密地方,以及把其他人或物品藏起來。
register.summaryEn: Hide away can describe someone staying alone because they feel upset, tired or unwilling to meet other people. Hide out is useful when someone stays in a secret place because other people are searching for them. Hide something away can describe putting presents, money, letters or other things somewhere difficult to find. The HIDE family helps you distinguish between hiding yourself, staying somewhere secretly and hiding another person or object.
